governing_framework: Dualis & Unity Framework (v0.40-Public) / DCLM Layer [0] Law Floor / DCCP Conserved Plane
operating_principle: Urgency is routing priority, NOT execution authority.

canonical_urgency_classes.U1: ATTENTION — Requires awareness during the next normal factory observation cycle.
canonical_urgency_classes.U2: PRIORITY — Should be routed ahead of ordinary queued work where capacity permits.
canonical_urgency_classes.U3: URGENT — Requires accelerated routing/observation and should be surfaced to the responsible desk promptly.
canonical_urgency_classes.U4: CRITICAL — Requires immediate factory attention and escalation through the existing authority chain.
canonical_urgency_classes.U5: OPERATOR — Explicit operator-directed matter. Operator authority must still be expressed through permitted authority mechanism, including ALLOW where required.

canonical_message_envelope.sequence: URGENCY -> TARGET -> REASON -> REQUIRED_RESPONSE -> EXPIRY -> AUTHORITY -> RECEIPT

routing_law.governing_sequence: DETECT -> CLASSIFY -> ROUTE -> CLAIM -> DCLM -> AUTHORITY CHECK -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> RECEIPT
prohibited_bypasses: override an existing operator ALLOW requirement

expiry_handling.rule: Support time-bounded urgency. If now > expiry, mark bulletin/route as EXPIRED, do not silently execute stale work, preserve historical audit receipt, require fresh routing.

deduplication.rule: canonical bulletin -> canonical serialization -> TASK_HASH (SHA256). Identical canonical task must not be executed twice regardless of re-reading or multiple watchers.

board_interlock.canonical_path: Operator / authorized source -> FACTORY_BULLETIN_BOARD -> Messenger / watcher -> Urgency classification -> Responsible desk / factory unit -> Claim -> DCLM -> Authority check -> Execution -> Evidence / verification -> Receipt.
board_interlock.principle: The Bulletin Board remains the doorbell. It is not the factory floor. The Messenger routes the bell; the factory performs the work.
